---
title: "Module 07: Spatial transcriptomics normalization and clustering"
output: html_document
date: "2026-08-11"
---

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# MODULE 07 — Spatial normalization, integration, and clustering
#==============================================================================

# Purpose:
#   Normalize the QC-filtered spatial transcriptomics dataset generated in
#   Module 06 using SCTransform, perform PCA, evaluate sample-associated
#   structure before correction, construct an initial clustering solution,
#   apply Harmony batch correction using sample identity, construct the final
#   nearest-neighbor graph and clusters from Harmony embeddings, generate
#   UMAP and t-SNE representations, examine cluster composition across slides,
#   visualize final clusters in tissue space, validate the processed object,
#   and save the integrated spatial Seurat object for downstream analyses.
#
# Input:
#   data/processed/spatial/
#     spatial_QC_filtered_seurat.rds
#
# Primary output object:
#   data/processed/spatial/
#     spatial_integrated_clustered_seurat.rds
#
# Output tables:
#   results/spatial/processing/
#
# Output figures:
#   figures/spatial/processing/
#
# Processing parameters:
#   Normalization:       SCTransform
#   Input assay:         Spatial
#   Normalized assay:    SCT
#   PCA components:      30
#   Dimensions used:     1:30
#   Clustering resolution:
#                       0.5
#   Batch variable:      sample
#   Batch correction:    Harmony
#
# Notes:
#   - Raw Spatial counts are retained for downstream inferCNV and CARD.
#   - Uncorrected PCA/UMAP/t-SNE plots are retained as batch-effect
#     diagnostics.
#   - Final clustering is performed on the Harmony representation.
#   - Graph names are defined explicitly so FindClusters() cannot
#     accidentally use an unintended graph.
#   - Differential expression is performed separately in Module 08.
#==============================================================================


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load required packages
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(harmony)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(future)
  library(here)
})


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Reproducibility settings
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(1234)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Define analysis parameters
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

input_assay <- "Spatial"

normalized_assay <- "SCT"

number_pcs <- 30

analysis_dimensions <- 1:30

clustering_resolution <- 0.5

harmony_group_variable <- "sample"

uncorrected_nn_graph <- "SCT_pca_nn"

uncorrected_snn_graph <- "SCT_pca_snn"

harmony_nn_graph <- "SCT_harmony_nn"

harmony_snn_graph <- "SCT_harmony_snn"


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Define repository paths
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

processed_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "spatial"
)

results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "spatial",
  "processing"
)

figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "spatial",
  "processing"
)

directories_to_create <- c(
  processed_directory,
  results_directory,
  figure_directory
)

for (directory in directories_to_create) {
  dir.create(
    directory,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
}

input_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "spatial_QC_filtered_seurat.rds"
)

output_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "spatial_integrated_clustered_seurat.rds"
)

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "MODULE 07 — Spatial normalization, integration, and clustering\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "Repository root:    ", here::here(), "\n",
  "Input object:       ", input_file, "\n",
  "Processed data:     ", processed_directory, "\n",
  "Results directory: ", results_directory, "\n",
  "Figure directory:  ", figure_directory, "\n",
  "============================================================\n\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Validate and load Module 06 output
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!file.exists(input_file)) {
  stop(
    "Module 06 output was not found:\n",
    input_file,
    "\n\nRun 06_spatial_assembly_qc.Rmd before Module 07."
  )
}

cat(
  "Loading QC-filtered spatial Seurat object...\n"
)

spatial_object <- readRDS(
  input_file
)

if (!inherits(spatial_object, "Seurat")) {
  stop(
    "Loaded input file is not a valid Seurat object."
  )
}

if (!input_assay %in% Seurat::Assays(spatial_object)) {
  stop(
    "Spatial assay was not found in the input Seurat object."
  )
}

required_metadata <- c(
  "sample",
  "condition",
  "nCount_Spatial",
  "nFeature_Spatial",
  "percent.mt"
)

missing_metadata <- setdiff(
  required_metadata,
  colnames(spatial_object@meta.data)
)

if (length(missing_metadata) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Required metadata column(s) missing from input object:\n",
    paste(
      missing_metadata,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

expected_samples <- c(
  "Normal_Tissue",
  "Niacin_Treatment",
  "Vehicle_1",
  "Vehicle_2"
)

observed_samples <- sort(
  unique(
    as.character(
      spatial_object$sample
    )
  )
)

if (!identical(
  sort(expected_samples),
  observed_samples
)) {
  stop(
    "Unexpected spatial sample identities were detected.\n",
    "Observed samples: ",
    paste(
      observed_samples,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

expected_images <- c(
  "Naive_A9",
  "Niacin2_B5",
  "Vehicle1_C5",
  "Vehicle2_D5"
)

missing_images <- setdiff(
  expected_images,
  Seurat::Images(spatial_object)
)

if (length(missing_images) > 0) {
  stop(
    "One or more expected spatial images are missing:\n",
    paste(
      missing_images,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

Seurat::DefaultAssay(
  spatial_object
) <- input_assay

cat(
  "Object loaded successfully:\n",
  "  Features: ", nrow(spatial_object), "\n",
  "  Spots:    ", ncol(spatial_object), "\n",
  "  Samples:  ",
  length(
    unique(
      spatial_object$sample
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  "  Images:   ",
  length(
    Seurat::Images(
      spatial_object
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Inspect Spatial assay layers
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Inspecting Spatial assay layers\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

spatial_layers <- SeuratObject::Layers(
  spatial_object[[input_assay]]
)

print(
  spatial_layers
)

if (sum(grepl("^counts", spatial_layers)) > 1) {
  cat(
    "\nMultiple Spatial count layers detected.\n",
    "Joining layers before SCTransform...\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  spatial_object <- SeuratObject::JoinLayers(
    spatial_object,
    assay = input_assay
  )
}

cat(
  "\nSpatial assay layers after layer check:\n"
)

print(
  SeuratObject::Layers(
    spatial_object[[input_assay]]
  )
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configure memory settings for SCTransform
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

options(
  future.globals.maxSize = 4 * 1024^3
)

future::plan(
  "sequential"
)

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Configuring SCTransform memory settings\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Future plan: sequential\n",
  "Maximum exported globals size: 4 GB\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Normalize spatial expression using SCTransform
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Running SCTransform normalization\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

spatial_object <- Seurat::SCTransform(
  object = spatial_object,
  assay = input_assay,
  new.assay.name = normalized_assay,
  variable.features.n = 3000,
  return.only.var.genes = FALSE,
  verbose = FALSE
)

if (!normalized_assay %in% Seurat::Assays(spatial_object)) {
  stop(
    "SCTransform did not create the expected SCT assay."
  )
}

Seurat::DefaultAssay(
  spatial_object
) <- normalized_assay

cat(
  "SCTransform completed successfully.\n",
  "Variable features identified: ",
  length(
    Seurat::VariableFeatures(
      spatial_object
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Perform principal component analysis
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Performing principal component analysis\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

spatial_object <- Seurat::RunPCA(
  object = spatial_object,
  assay = normalized_assay,
  features = Seurat::VariableFeatures(
    spatial_object
  ),
  npcs = number_pcs,
  verbose = FALSE
)

if (!"pca" %in% names(spatial_object@reductions)) {
  stop(
    "PCA reduction was not created successfully."
  )
}

cat(
  "PCA completed successfully.\n",
  "Principal components calculated: ",
  ncol(
    Seurat::Embeddings(
      spatial_object,
      reduction = "pca"
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Generate PCA elbow plot
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

pca_elbow_plot <- Seurat::ElbowPlot(
  spatial_object,
  ndims = number_pcs
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Spatial PCA Elbow Plot"
  )

print(
  pca_elbow_plot
)

pca_elbow_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_PCA_elbow_plot.png"
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = pca_elbow_file,
  plot = pca_elbow_plot,
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Assess sample-associated structure in PCA space
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Assessing sample-associated structure before Harmony\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

pca_sample_plot <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  spatial_object,
  reduction = "pca",
  group.by = "sample"
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Spatial PCA by Sample"
  )

pca_condition_plot <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  spatial_object,
  reduction = "pca",
  group.by = "condition"
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Spatial PCA by Condition"
  )

print(
  pca_sample_plot
)

print(
  pca_condition_plot
)

pca_sample_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_PCA_by_sample.png"
)

pca_condition_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_PCA_by_condition.png"
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = pca_sample_file,
  plot = pca_sample_plot,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = pca_condition_file,
  plot = pca_condition_plot,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Construct uncorrected PCA nearest-neighbor graph
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Constructing uncorrected PCA neighbor graph\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

spatial_object <- Seurat::FindNeighbors(
  object = spatial_object,
  reduction = "pca",
  dims = analysis_dimensions,
  graph.name = c(
    uncorrected_nn_graph,
    uncorrected_snn_graph
  ),
  verbose = FALSE
)

available_graphs <- names(
  spatial_object@graphs
)

cat(
  "Available graphs after uncorrected FindNeighbors():\n"
)

print(
  available_graphs
)

if (!uncorrected_snn_graph %in% available_graphs) {
  stop(
    "Expected uncorrected SNN graph was not created:\n",
    uncorrected_snn_graph
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Perform initial uncorrected clustering
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Performing initial PCA-based clustering\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

spatial_object <- Seurat::FindClusters(
  object = spatial_object,
  graph.name = uncorrected_snn_graph,
  resolution = clustering_resolution,
  cluster.name = "uncorrected_cluster",
  random.seed = 1234,
  verbose = FALSE
)

if (!"uncorrected_cluster" %in% colnames(spatial_object@meta.data)) {
  stop(
    "Initial uncorrected clustering metadata was not created."
  )
}

cat(
  "Initial PCA-based clusters identified: ",
  length(
    unique(
      spatial_object$uncorrected_cluster
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13. Generate uncorrected UMAP
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

spatial_object <- Seurat::RunUMAP(
  object = spatial_object,
  reduction = "pca",
  dims = analysis_dimensions,
  reduction.name = "umap_uncorrected",
  reduction.key = "UMAPuncorrected_",
  seed.use = 1234,
  verbose = FALSE
)

uncorrected_umap_sample <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  spatial_object,
  reduction = "umap_uncorrected",
  group.by = "sample"
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Uncorrected Spatial UMAP by Sample"
  )

uncorrected_umap_condition <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  spatial_object,
  reduction = "umap_uncorrected",
  group.by = "condition"
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Uncorrected Spatial UMAP by Condition"
  )

uncorrected_umap_cluster <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  spatial_object,
  reduction = "umap_uncorrected",
  group.by = "uncorrected_cluster",
  label = TRUE,
  repel = TRUE
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Uncorrected Spatial UMAP by Cluster"
  )

print(
  uncorrected_umap_sample
)

print(
  uncorrected_umap_condition
)

print(
  uncorrected_umap_cluster
)

uncorrected_umap_sample_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_uncorrected_UMAP_by_sample.png"
)

uncorrected_umap_condition_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_uncorrected_UMAP_by_condition.png"
)

uncorrected_umap_cluster_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_uncorrected_UMAP_by_cluster.png"
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = uncorrected_umap_sample_file,
  plot = uncorrected_umap_sample,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = uncorrected_umap_condition_file,
  plot = uncorrected_umap_condition,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = uncorrected_umap_cluster_file,
  plot = uncorrected_umap_cluster,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 14. Generate uncorrected t-SNE
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

spatial_object <- Seurat::RunTSNE(
  object = spatial_object,
  reduction = "pca",
  dims = analysis_dimensions,
  reduction.name = "tsne_uncorrected",
  reduction.key = "tSNEuncorrected_",
  seed.use = 1234,
  check_duplicates = FALSE
)

uncorrected_tsne_sample <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  spatial_object,
  reduction = "tsne_uncorrected",
  group.by = "sample"
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Uncorrected Spatial t-SNE by Sample"
  )

uncorrected_tsne_cluster <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  spatial_object,
  reduction = "tsne_uncorrected",
  group.by = "uncorrected_cluster",
  label = TRUE,
  repel = TRUE
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Uncorrected Spatial t-SNE by Cluster"
  )

print(
  uncorrected_tsne_sample
)

print(
  uncorrected_tsne_cluster
)

uncorrected_tsne_sample_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_uncorrected_tSNE_by_sample.png"
)

uncorrected_tsne_cluster_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_uncorrected_tSNE_by_cluster.png"
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = uncorrected_tsne_sample_file,
  plot = uncorrected_tsne_sample,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = uncorrected_tsne_cluster_file,
  plot = uncorrected_tsne_cluster,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 15. Save uncorrected batch-assessment overview
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

uncorrected_overview <- (
  pca_sample_plot |
  uncorrected_umap_sample |
  uncorrected_tsne_sample
)

print(
  uncorrected_overview
)

uncorrected_overview_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_uncorrected_batch_assessment.png"
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = uncorrected_overview_file,
  plot = uncorrected_overview,
  width = 18,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 16. Run Harmony batch correction
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Running Harmony batch correction\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Grouping variable: ",
  harmony_group_variable,
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

spatial_object <- harmony::RunHarmony(
  object = spatial_object,
  group.by.vars = harmony_group_variable,
  reduction.use = "pca",
  dims.use = analysis_dimensions,
  reduction.save = "harmony",
  project.dim = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

if (!"harmony" %in% names(spatial_object@reductions)) {
  stop(
    "Harmony reduction was not created successfully."
  )
}

harmony_embeddings <- Seurat::Embeddings(
  spatial_object,
  reduction = "harmony"
)

if (ncol(harmony_embeddings) < max(analysis_dimensions)) {
  stop(
    "Harmony produced fewer dimensions than required for downstream analysis."
  )
}

cat(
  "Harmony completed successfully:\n",
  "  Dimensions: ",
  ncol(harmony_embeddings),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 17. Examine Harmony embedding by sample
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

harmony_sample_plot <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  spatial_object,
  reduction = "harmony",
  group.by = "sample"
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Harmony Embedding by Sample"
  )

harmony_condition_plot <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  spatial_object,
  reduction = "harmony",
  group.by = "condition"
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Harmony Embedding by Condition"
  )

print(
  harmony_sample_plot
)

print(
  harmony_condition_plot
)

harmony_sample_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_Harmony_by_sample.png"
)

harmony_condition_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_Harmony_by_condition.png"
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = harmony_sample_file,
  plot = harmony_sample_plot,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = harmony_condition_file,
  plot = harmony_condition_plot,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 18. Construct Harmony nearest-neighbor graph
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Constructing Harmony neighbor graph\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

spatial_object <- Seurat::FindNeighbors(
  object = spatial_object,
  reduction = "harmony",
  dims = analysis_dimensions,
  graph.name = c(
    harmony_nn_graph,
    harmony_snn_graph
  ),
  verbose = FALSE
)

available_graphs <- names(
  spatial_object@graphs
)

cat(
  "Available graphs after Harmony FindNeighbors():\n"
)

print(
  available_graphs
)

if (!harmony_snn_graph %in% available_graphs) {
  stop(
    "Expected Harmony SNN graph was not created:\n",
    harmony_snn_graph
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 19. Perform final Harmony-based clustering
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Performing final Harmony-based clustering\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

spatial_object <- Seurat::FindClusters(
  object = spatial_object,
  graph.name = harmony_snn_graph,
  resolution = clustering_resolution,
  cluster.name = "spatial_cluster",
  random.seed = 1234,
  verbose = FALSE
)

if (!"spatial_cluster" %in% colnames(spatial_object@meta.data)) {
  stop(
    "Final Harmony cluster metadata was not created."
  )
}

spatial_object$spatial_cluster <- as.character(
  spatial_object$spatial_cluster
)

spatial_object$seurat_clusters <- spatial_object$spatial_cluster

spatial_object$SCT_snn_res.0.5 <- spatial_object$spatial_cluster

Seurat::Idents(
  spatial_object
) <- "spatial_cluster"

number_clusters <- length(
  unique(
    spatial_object$spatial_cluster
  )
)

cat(
  "Final Harmony clustering completed successfully.\n",
  "Clusters identified: ",
  number_clusters,
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "\nSpots per final cluster:\n"
)

print(
  table(
    spatial_object$spatial_cluster
  )
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 20. Generate final Harmony UMAP
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Generating final Harmony UMAP\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

spatial_object <- Seurat::RunUMAP(
  object = spatial_object,
  reduction = "harmony",
  dims = analysis_dimensions,
  reduction.name = "umap",
  reduction.key = "UMAP_",
  seed.use = 1234,
  verbose = FALSE
)

if (!"umap" %in% names(spatial_object@reductions)) {
  stop(
    "Final Harmony UMAP was not created successfully."
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 21. Generate final Harmony t-SNE
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Generating final Harmony t-SNE\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

spatial_object <- Seurat::RunTSNE(
  object = spatial_object,
  reduction = "harmony",
  dims = analysis_dimensions,
  reduction.name = "tsne",
  reduction.key = "tSNE_",
  seed.use = 1234,
  check_duplicates = FALSE
)

if (!"tsne" %in% names(spatial_object@reductions)) {
  stop(
    "Final Harmony t-SNE was not created successfully."
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 22. Visualize final UMAP
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

final_umap_cluster <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  spatial_object,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "spatial_cluster",
  label = TRUE,
  repel = TRUE
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Harmony Spatial Clusters"
  )

final_umap_sample <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  spatial_object,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "sample"
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Harmony UMAP by Sample"
  )

final_umap_condition <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  spatial_object,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "condition"
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Harmony UMAP by Condition"
  )

print(
  final_umap_cluster
)

print(
  final_umap_sample
)

print(
  final_umap_condition
)

final_umap_cluster_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_Harmony_UMAP_clusters.png"
)

final_umap_sample_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_Harmony_UMAP_by_sample.png"
)

final_umap_condition_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_Harmony_UMAP_by_condition.png"
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = final_umap_cluster_file,
  plot = final_umap_cluster,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = final_umap_sample_file,
  plot = final_umap_sample,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = final_umap_condition_file,
  plot = final_umap_condition,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 26. Examine final cluster composition by sample
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cluster_sample_counts <- spatial_object@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(
    spatial_cluster,
    sample,
    condition,
    name = "spots"
  )

cluster_sample_proportions <- cluster_sample_counts %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    spatial_cluster
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    percent_of_cluster =
      100 *
      spots /
      sum(spots)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Final cluster composition by sample\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

)

    fill = sample
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(
    width = 0.8
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(

  ggplot2::theme_classic(

  ) +

    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),

    )
  )

# 31. Save processing parameter table
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

processing_parameters <- data.frame(
  parameter = c(
    "input_assay",
    "normalized_assay",
    "normalization_method",
    "variable_features",
    "pca_components",
    "analysis_dimensions",
    "uncorrected_reduction",
    "batch_variable",
    "batch_correction",
    "final_reduction",
    "clustering_resolution",
    "uncorrected_snn_graph",
    "harmony_snn_graph"
  ),
  value = c(
    input_assay,
    normalized_assay,
    "SCTransform",
    3000,
    number_pcs,
    paste0(
      min(analysis_dimensions),
      ":",
      max(analysis_dimensions)
    ),
    "PCA",
    harmony_group_variable,
    "Harmony",
    "Harmony",
    clustering_resolution,
    uncorrected_snn_graph,
    harmony_snn_graph
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

processing_parameter_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_processing_parameters.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  processing_parameters,
  processing_parameter_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 32. Validate final processed spatial object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Validating integrated spatial Seurat object\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

if (!inherits(spatial_object, "Seurat")) {
  stop(
    "Final processed object is not a valid Seurat object."
  )
}

required_assays <- c(
  input_assay,
  normalized_assay
)

missing_assays <- setdiff(
  required_assays,
  Seurat::Assays(spatial_object)
)

if (length(missing_assays) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Required assay(s) missing from final object:\n",
    paste(
      missing_assays,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

required_reductions <- c(
  "pca",
  "umap_uncorrected",
  "tsne_uncorrected",
  "harmony",
  "umap",
  "tsne"
)

missing_reductions <- setdiff(
  required_reductions,
  names(spatial_object@reductions)
)

if (length(missing_reductions) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Required dimensionality reduction(s) missing:\n",
    paste(
      missing_reductions,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

required_cluster_metadata <- c(
  "uncorrected_cluster",
  "spatial_cluster",
  "seurat_clusters",
  "SCT_snn_res.0.5"
)

missing_cluster_metadata <- setdiff(
  required_cluster_metadata,
  colnames(spatial_object@meta.data)
)

if (length(missing_cluster_metadata) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Required clustering metadata column(s) missing:\n",
    paste(
      missing_cluster_metadata,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

required_graphs <- c(
  uncorrected_nn_graph,
  uncorrected_snn_graph,
  harmony_nn_graph,
  harmony_snn_graph
)

missing_graphs <- setdiff(
  required_graphs,
  names(spatial_object@graphs)
)

if (length(missing_graphs) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Required Seurat graph(s) missing:\n",
    paste(
      missing_graphs,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

missing_images_final <- setdiff(
  expected_images,
  Seurat::Images(spatial_object)
)

if (length(missing_images_final) > 0) {
  stop(
    "One or more spatial images were lost during processing:\n",
    paste(
      missing_images_final,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

if (anyDuplicated(colnames(spatial_object)) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Duplicated spot barcodes detected in the processed spatial object."
  )
}

if (any(is.na(spatial_object$spatial_cluster))) {
  stop(
    "Missing final spatial cluster assignments were detected."
  )
}

cat(
  "Integrated spatial object validation completed successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 33. Save integrated spatial Seurat object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Saving integrated spatial Seurat object\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

saveRDS(
  object = spatial_object,
  file = output_file,
  compress = TRUE
)

if (!file.exists(output_file)) {
  stop(
    "Integrated spatial Seurat object was not saved successfully:\n",
    output_file
  )
}

cat(
  "Integrated spatial Seurat object saved successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 34. Validate expected Module 07 outputs
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

expected_result_files <- c(
  cluster_composition_file,
  cluster_summary_file,
  processing_parameter_file
)

expected_figure_files <- c(
  pca_elbow_file,
  pca_sample_file,
  pca_condition_file,
  uncorrected_umap_sample_file,
  uncorrected_umap_condition_file,
  uncorrected_umap_cluster_file,
  uncorrected_tsne_sample_file,
  uncorrected_tsne_cluster_file,
  uncorrected_overview_file,
  harmony_sample_file,
  harmony_condition_file,
  final_umap_cluster_file,
  final_umap_sample_file,
  final_umap_condition_file,
  final_umap_overview_file,
  final_tsne_cluster_file,
  final_tsne_sample_file,
  batch_correction_comparison_file,
  cluster_composition_plot_file,
  spatial_cluster_overview_file,
  normal_cluster_file,
  niacin_cluster_file,
  vehicle1_cluster_file,
  vehicle2_cluster_file
)

missing_result_files <- expected_result_files[
  !file.exists(expected_result_files)
]

missing_figure_files <- expected_figure_files[
  !file.exists(expected_figure_files)
]

if (length(missing_result_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "One or more expected Module 07 result files were not created:\n",
    paste(
      missing_result_files,
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
}

if (length(missing_figure_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "One or more expected Module 07 figure files were not created:\n",
    paste(
      missing_figure_files,
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
}

cat(
  "All expected Module 07 outputs were created successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 35. Final module summary
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "MODULE 07 COMPLETE — Spatial normalization and clustering\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "Features:                ", nrow(spatial_object), "\n",
  "Spots:                   ", ncol(spatial_object), "\n",
  "Samples:                 ",
  length(
    unique(
      spatial_object$sample
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  "Spatial images:          ",
  length(
    Seurat::Images(
      spatial_object
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  "Normalization:           SCTransform\n",
  "Variable features:       ",
  length(
    Seurat::VariableFeatures(
      spatial_object
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  "PCA components:          ", number_pcs, "\n",
  "Dimensions used:         ",
  min(analysis_dimensions),
  ":",
  max(analysis_dimensions),
  "\n",
  "Batch correction:        Harmony\n",
  "Batch variable:          ", harmony_group_variable, "\n",
  "Clustering resolution:   ", clustering_resolution, "\n",
  "Final spatial clusters:  ", number_clusters, "\n",
  "\n",
  "Primary output:\n",
  "  ", output_file, "\n",
  "\n",
  "Processing tables:\n",
  "  ", results_directory, "\n",
  "\n",
  "Processing figures:\n",
  "  ", figure_directory, "\n",
  "\n",
  "Next module:\n",
  "  08_spatial_cluster_dea.Rmd\n",
  "============================================================\n\n",
  sep = ""
)
```
